updates.setting: Third back; inactive for San Diego
updates.text: Third back in Stone's explicit hierarchy (Jones-Drew, Anderson, Grimes; no committee). Inactive for San Diego as the packet's next healthy inactive once Nicks completed his full practice week, after Westhoff's unit check found no defined coverage job on him (one kicking-game snap in Week 3). Not a finding on his work; nothing charged to him on the recorded reps.
updates.source: Source: [Week 4 record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_04/output.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Jonathan Grimes handled the second-back workload for Jacksonville in 2013, with {{2013.regular.rushing_attempts}} carries, {{2013.regular.rushing_touchdowns:words}} rushing touchdowns and {{2013.regular.receiving_touchdowns:words}} receiving touchdown, and he is the third back in 2014. He is a flexible change-of-pace back with useful cuts, receiving value and enough burst for the core runs, and his assigned route work held from camp into the preseason games in 2013. Physical pickups in pass protection and power finishing are the less certain parts of his game.

transactions.text: Signed his rookie contract as an undrafted rookie
Claimed off waivers from Houston by Jacksonville
